nodes.name: NWS API
nodes.summary: Forecasts, alerts, observations and gridpoint data for the United States and its territories, as GeoJSON and JSON-LD.

auth.note: A descriptive User-Agent header is required; the docs say an API key will replace it in the future. Responses send access-control-allow-origin: *.

rateLimits.text: Not published numerically; a generous amount for typical use. Exceeding it returns an error and can be retried after the limit clears (typically within 5 seconds).

freshness.note: Alerts and observations are near real-time; forecasts follow each forecast office's cycle.

nodes.name: NWS GIS Portal (ArcGIS REST)
nodes.summary: ArcGIS REST MapServer and FeatureServer layers for SPC, WPC and CPC outlooks, precipitation and hazards, storm reports and surface observations.

auth.note: Responses echo the request Origin in access-control-allow-origin (checked 2026-09-21).

freshness.note: Varies by layer; each layer follows its source product's issuance.

nodes.notLiveReason: Deferred: outside the v1 live layers (NWS alerts and point forecast/observations). CORS works, so SPC, WPC and CPC layers here are the likeliest candidates for later map layers.

nodes.name: SPC GIS Data Feeds
nodes.summary: Storm Prediction Center convective and fire weather outlooks, watches and mesoscale discussions as GeoJSON, KML and shapefiles.

freshness.note: Update schedule is not documented on the data page; files follow each outlook issuance. Days 4-8 outlooks are experimental.

nodes.notLiveReason: Deferred: v1 live layers are limited to NWS alerts and NWS point forecast/observations. The GeoJSON feeds send access-control-allow-origin: * (checked 2026-09-21), so they are a candidate for a later layer.

nodes.name: WPC GIS Products
nodes.summary: Weather Prediction Center precipitation, excessive rainfall, winter weather and surface analysis products as KML and shapefiles.

freshness.note: Update schedule is not documented on the data page; products are issued multiple times daily in UTC.

sample.responseExcerpt:
HTML index page listing downloadable files, for example:
  artcc_boundaries.kml
  cave_artcc.kmz
  cave_statebounds.kmz
  modified_state_bnds.kml
(download only; no JSON API)

nodes.notLiveReason: Deferred: this feed is KML and shapefile downloads. The same WPC products are also served as browser-callable ArcGIS REST layers, listed under nws-gis-portal.

nodes.name: CPC GIS Data
nodes.summary: Climate Prediction Center drought, temperature and precipitation analyses and outlooks as shapefiles and GeoTIFFs on FTP. Coverage is worldwide because of one global precipitation grid; most other products are US-only.

freshness.note: Update schedule is not documented on the data page; cadence varies by product.

sample.responseExcerpt:
HTML page linking to FTP directories of shapefiles and GeoTIFFs, for example:
  https://ftp.cpc.ncep.noaa.gov/GIS/USDM_Products/precip/
  https://ftp.cpc.ncep.noaa.gov/GIS/GRADS_GIS/GeoTIFF/TEMP/
(FTP-hosted; not fetchable from a browser)

nodes.notLiveReason: These files are served over FTP as shapefiles and GeoTIFFs, which a browser cannot fetch directly. CPC outlooks are also served as ArcGIS REST layers, listed under nws-gis-portal.

nodes.name: CO-OPS Data API
nodes.summary: Observed and predicted water levels, tides, currents and meteorological readings from US coastal and Great Lakes stations, as JSON, XML or CSV.

auth.note: No key or token. Pass an application= parameter to identify your app in CO-OPS logs. Responses send access-control-allow-origin: *.

rateLimits.text: Not published numerically; CO-OPS throttles heavy or repeated queries from a single customer. Add delays between calls and request only the data you need.

freshness.note: Real-time observations are mostly 6-minute values; hourly, daily and monthly aggregates are also available, and verified data lags by about a month.

nodes.notLiveReason: Not wired into the v1 map: station-based point data with no bulk layer to draw yet.

nodes.name: CO-OPS Metadata API
nodes.summary: Station metadata for CO-OPS water level, tide prediction and current stations: details, sensors, datums, flood levels, harmonic constituents and nearby stations.

freshness.note: Station and sensor metadata; changes when stations are installed, moved or reconfigured.

nodes.notLiveReason: Not wired into the v1 map: station-based point data with no bulk layer to draw yet.

nodes.name: CO-OPS Derived Product API
nodes.summary: Analysis products built from CO-OPS water level records: sea level trends, high tide flooding, extreme water levels and monthly mean sea level.

freshness.note: Derived from long-term records and updated as each product is reprocessed, not a live feed.

nodes.notLiveReason: Not wired into the v1 map: station-based point data with no bulk layer to draw yet.

nodes.name: NDBC Real-Time Observations
nodes.summary: Latest 45 days of buoy and C-MAN station observations (winds, waves, pressure, air and sea temperature) as plain-text files per station.

auth.note: Public files; no key. FTP access is being phased out in favor of HTTPS.

rateLimits.text: No numeric limit; NDBC asks users to keep retrievals to a minimum to avoid overloading the servers.

freshness.note: Most stations report hourly and data is mostly available 25 minutes after the hour.

nodes.notLiveReason: Not wired into the v1 map: one text file per station, so a layer needs the station list and per-station fetches.

nodes.name: DART Tsunami Buoy Data
nodes.summary: Deep-ocean bottom-pressure water column heights from NOAA's DART tsunami detection stations, as per-station real-time text files.

owner.program: NDBC DART® (National Tsunami Hazard Mitigation Program)

auth.note: Public files served alongside NDBC real-time observations, as [stationid].dart. NCEI is the long-term archive for recovered DART data.

rateLimits.text: No numeric limit published; the NDBC real-time access guide asks users to keep retrievals to a minimum.

freshness.note: Real-time files list water column height in 15-minute steps; DART II stations transmit every six hours in standard mode, with high-rate event mode when a tsunami is detected.

#YY  MM DD hh mm ss T   HEIGHT
#yr  mo dy hr mn  s -        m
2026 09 10 18 00 00 1 5421.034
2026 09 10 17 45 00 1 5421.057
(abbreviated)

nodes.notLiveReason: Not wired into the v1 map: per-station text files, and the height series is only meaningful as a time-series chart.

nodes.name: Climate Data Online (CDO) Web Services v2
nodes.summary: Token-gated REST API over NCEI's Climate Data Online holdings: browse datasets, data categories, data types, locations and stations, then pull daily, monthly and annual climate observations such as GHCN-Daily and Global Summary of the Month.

auth.note: Free token, emailed on request; send it in a `token` request header.

rateLimits.text: Each token is limited to 5 requests per second and 10,000 requests per day; results are capped at 1,000 per request.

freshness.note: Dataset dependent; recent data trails observation time and archive-quality data can lag 45-60 days.

nodes.notLiveReason: Not wired into the v1 map: requires a per-user token that cannot be shipped in a static app, and results are station time series rather than a map layer.

nodes.name: NCEI Access Data Service
nodes.summary: Tokenless REST API that subsets NCEI datasets by station, date range, data type and bounding box. Includes GHCN-Daily (dataset daily-summaries, 100,000+ stations in 180 countries) and monthly summaries, as JSON, CSV or NetCDF.

freshness.note: Dataset dependent; active US GHCN-Daily stations update from real-time feeds and are replaced by archive-quality data later.

nodes.notLiveReason: Not wired into the v1 map: station time series and subsets, not a ready-made map layer.

nodes.name: NCEI Storm Events Database (bulk CSV)
nodes.summary: Bulk gzipped CSV files of US storm and weather events since 1950 (details, locations and fatalities tables), one file per year. Files are downloads, not a query API.

freshness.note: Yearly files are regenerated periodically; the 2026 details file was last generated 2026-09-18.

sample.responseExcerpt:
Directory listing of files such as:
Storm-Data-Bulk-csv-Format.pdf
StormEvents_details-ftp_v1.0_d2026_c20260918.csv.gz
StormEvents_details-ftp_v1.0_d2025_c20260819.csv.gz
(abbreviated)

nodes.notLiveReason: Not wired into the v1 map: static bulk downloads with no query API, so nothing to fetch on demand.

auth.note: Public files; no key or token. A descriptive User-Agent is good practice.

freshness.note: Advisories are issued about every six hours per active storm (intermediate updates more often); CurrentStorms.json is empty when no storms are active.

nodes.name: Tsunami Warning Center Message Feeds
nodes.summary: Atom and CAP 1.2 XML feeds of tsunami warning, watch, advisory and information messages from the National and Pacific Tsunami Warning Centers.

auth.note: Public feeds; PAAQ* files come from the National Tsunami Warning Center (Alaska), PHEB* from the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center (Hawaii).

freshness.note: Event-driven: messages appear when a center issues a product for an earthquake or tsunami, otherwise the feed holds the last message.

nodes.notLiveReason: Not wired into the v1 map: XML (Atom/CAP) feeds that only carry the latest event and are usually an information statement, with no query API.

nodes.name: GOES-R ABI imagery and products (AWS Open Data)
nodes.summary: Full GOES-East and GOES-West ABI imagery and derived products (cloud and moisture imagery, sea surface temperature, fire and lightning) as NetCDF files in public S3 buckets, organised by product, year, day-of-year and hour. Files are downloads listed through the S3 API, not a query API.

auth.note: Public buckets, no account needed. Buckets are per satellite (noaa-goes19 for GOES-East, noaa-goes18 for GOES-West).

freshness.note: New files arrive every 5 to 15 minutes depending on product and scan mode.

nodes.notLiveReason: Not wired into the v1 map: full-disk NetCDF files of tens of MB each, listed through S3 with no tile or image endpoint to draw on the globe.

nodes.name: NESDIS STAR GOES image CDN
nodes.summary: Pre-rendered GOES-East and GOES-West JPEG imagery (GeoColor, infrared, water vapor and other bands) for the CONUS, full disk and regional sectors, at several resolutions, from a plain directory-listing CDN. Includes a stable latest image per sector and band.

owner.program: Center for Satellite Applications and Research (STAR), GOES Image Viewer

freshness.note: CONUS GeoColor refreshes about every 5 minutes.

sample.responseExcerpt:
Directory listing of files such as:

20262562306_GOES19-ABI-CONUS-GEOCOLOR-10000x6000.jpg
20262562306_GOES19-ABI-CONUS-GEOCOLOR-1250x750.jpg
(abbreviated)

nodes.notLiveReason: Not wired into the v1 map: images are unprojected JPEGs with no georeferencing metadata, so they cannot be draped on the globe without extra work.

nodes.name: NEXRAD Level II radar archive (AWS Open Data)
nodes.summary: Raw Level II base data (reflectivity, velocity, spectrum width) from the national network of WSR-88D weather radars, as one file per volume scan under radar/date/site keys in a public S3 bucket. Files are downloads listed through the S3 API.

owner.program: NEXRAD (WSR-88D), distributed via NOAA Open Data Dissemination

auth.note: Public bucket, no account needed.

freshness.note: A new volume scan every 4 to 10 minutes per radar site; real-time chunks are in a separate bucket.

nodes.notLiveReason: Not wired into the v1 map: binary Level II volume files that need a radar decoder, listed through S3 with no image or tile endpoint.

nodes.name: MRMS multi-radar precipitation and severe-weather products (AWS Open Data)
nodes.summary: Multi-Radar Multi-Sensor (MRMS) gridded products for the contiguous US and other domains, blending radar, satellite, lightning and model data (radar mosaics, precipitation rate and accumulations, echo tops, hail size), as GRIB2 files in a public S3 bucket, one prefix per product.

owner.program: NCEP Central Operations / NSSL, Multi-Radar Multi-Sensor (MRMS)

auth.note: Public bucket, no account needed. A parallel feed is on https://mrms.ncep.noaa.gov/data/.

freshness.note: Most products update every 2 minutes.

nodes.notLiveReason: Not wired into the v1 map: GRIB2 grids that need decoding before they can be drawn, and no tile or image endpoint.

nodes.name: JPSS (NOAA-20 / VIIRS) satellite data (AWS Open Data)
nodes.summary: Polar-orbiting JPSS instrument data (VIIRS imagery, ATMS, CrIS) and derived products from NOAA-20, plus sibling buckets for other JPSS satellites, as files in public S3 buckets organised by product.

owner.program: Joint Polar Satellite System (JPSS), NOAA Open Data Dissemination

auth.note: Public buckets, no account needed. NOAA-21 and Suomi NPP use sibling buckets.

freshness.note: Granules arrive continuously as each pass is processed, typically within hours of observation.

nodes.notLiveReason: Not wired into the v1 map: swath granules in instrument-specific formats that need processing before display.

nodes.name: NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP
nodes.summary: ERDDAP data server for gridded and tabular satellite-derived ocean products (sea surface temperature, chlorophyll, ocean color, winds, sea ice) with a REST API: search datasets, then subset by time, area and variable and download as CSV, JSON, NetCDF, GeoTIFF or PNG, or view through WMS.

freshness.note: Varies by dataset from hourly composites to monthly climatologies.

nodes.name: NOMADS model data server (NCEP)

auth.note: No key needed.

freshness.note: New cycles appear as each model run finishes.

nodes.notLiveReason: Not wired into the v1 map: GRIB2 grids that need decoding before they can be drawn, and no tile or image endpoint.

nodes.name: GFS global forecast model (AWS Open Data)
nodes.summary: Global Forecast System output from NCEP as GRIB2 files in a public S3 bucket, one prefix per date and cycle (gfs.YYYYMMDD/HH/), with the GDAS analysis and ensemble Kalman filter (enkfgdas) products alongside.

owner.program: NCEP Environmental Modeling Center, Global Forecast System (GFS)

auth.note: Public bucket, no account needed.

freshness.note: Four cycles a day (00, 06, 12, 18 UTC); forecast hours for each cycle appear as the run completes.

nodes.notLiveReason: Not wired into the v1 map: GRIB2 model output that needs decoding before it can be drawn, and no tile or image endpoint.

nodes.name: HRRR hourly rapid-refresh model (AWS Open Data)

owner.program: NCEP Environmental Modeling Center, High-Resolution Rapid Refresh (HRRR)

auth.note: Public bucket, no account needed. The .idx files let you fetch a single variable with an HTTP Range request.

freshness.note: A new cycle every hour.

nodes.notLiveReason: Not wired into the v1 map: GRIB2 model output that needs decoding before it can be drawn, and no tile or image endpoint.

nodes.name: GEFS global ensemble forecast (AWS Open Data)
nodes.summary: Global Ensemble Forecast System output from NCEP as GRIB2 files in a public S3 bucket, one prefix per date and cycle (gefs.YYYYMMDD/HH/) with atmos, chem and wave sub-folders.

owner.program: NCEP Environmental Modeling Center, Global Ensemble Forecast System (GEFS)

auth.note: Public bucket, no account needed.

freshness.note: Four cycles a day (00, 06, 12, 18 UTC).

nodes.notLiveReason: Not wired into the v1 map: GRIB2 model output that needs decoding before it can be drawn, and no tile or image endpoint.

nodes.name: National Blend of Models (AWS Open Data)
nodes.summary: National Blend of Models guidance, a statistically post-processed blend of many models, as GRIB2 files in a public S3 bucket, one prefix per date and hour (blend.YYYYMMDD/HH/) with core, qmd and text sub-folders.

owner.program: NWS Meteorological Development Laboratory, National Blend of Models (NBM)

auth.note: Public bucket, no account needed.

freshness.note: A new run every hour.

nodes.notLiveReason: Not wired into the v1 map: GRIB2 model output that needs decoding before it can be drawn, and no tile or image endpoint.

nodes.name: NOAA Fisheries FOSS landings API

owner.program: Office of Science and Technology, FOSS

auth.note: No key needed. Responses carry no CORS headers, and requests that send an Origin header get a 403 (checked 2026-09-23), so it cannot be called from a browser page.

freshness.note: Annual statistics, updated as each year is finalized.

nodes.notLiveReason: Not wired into the v1 map: annual statistics rather than a map layer, and no CORS support, so a page in the browser cannot call it.

auth.note: Responses echo the request Origin in access-control-allow-origin (checked 2026-09-23).

nodes.notLiveReason: Deferred: outside the v1 live layers. CORS works and the NOAA chart WMTS is a plausible later basemap overlay. Charts are not for navigation.

nodes.name: NCEI magnetic declination API (World Magnetic Model)
nodes.summary: NCEI geomagnetic calculator web service returning magnetic declination and related field values for a latitude and longitude, computed from the World Magnetic Model.

freshness.note: Computed on request from the current model epoch; the model is revised about every five years.

nodes.name: NOAA CORS Network data (AWS S3)
nodes.summary: Public S3 bucket noaa-cors-pds with NOAA CORS Network GNSS data from the National Geodetic Survey, including daily RINEX observation files organised as rinex/<year>/<day-of-year>/<station>/, alongside coordinate and plot folders.

auth.note: Anonymous S3 listing and download work; access-control-allow-origin: * (checked 2026-09-23).

freshness.note: New daily RINEX files are added per station; NCEI's CLASS archive is the route for older or bulk orders.

nodes.notLiveReason: Deferred: GNSS observation files, not a map layer for v1.

nodes.name: NCEI OneStop search API
nodes.summary: JSON search API behind data.noaa.gov/onestop, NCEI's dataset discovery system. POST a JSON body (e.g. a queryText query with page max/offset) to /search/collection; each hit is a collection with title, date range and download or service links (FTP, THREDDS and others). It finds datasets and points to where to get them; it does not serve the data itself.

auth.note: No key. GET returns 400 (a JSON body is required); POST works and returns access-control-allow-origin: * (checked 2026-09-23).

freshness.note: Catalog records are updated as providers publish or revise metadata; no fixed schedule is documented.

nodes.name: NOAA datasets on the AWS Registry of Open Data
nodes.summary: The registry's NOAA collection page lists NOAA Open Data Dissemination (NODD) datasets hosted in public AWS S3 buckets, such as NEXRAD, GOES, GFS and HRRR, Integrated Surface Database and World Ocean Database. owner.program: NOAA Open Data Dissemination (NODD) via AWS Registry of Open Data

freshness.note: Entries are added or changed as datasets join or leave NODD; no fixed schedule is documented.

nodes.notLiveReason: Deferred: an HTML dataset directory with no API, not a map layer for v1.

nodes.name: SWPC alerts, watches and NOAA space weather scales

auth.note: Public files; no key or token. Responses send access-control-allow-origin: * (checked 2026-09-24).

rateLimits.text: Not published. The files are static JSON regenerated on a schedule, so polling faster than they update gains nothing.

freshness.note: noaa-scales.json is refreshed every few minutes; alerts.json lists messages from the past few days as they are issued; the 3-day forecast is issued twice daily.

nodes.notLiveReason: Not a map layer: planet-wide scale levels and free-text messages with no geometry to draw.

auth.note: Public files; no key or token. Responses send access-control-allow-origin: * (checked 2026-09-24).

rateLimits.text: Not published. The files are static JSON regenerated on a schedule, so polling faster than they update gains nothing.

freshness.note: Kp is issued for each 3-hour interval; planetary_k_index_1m.json gives a running one-minute estimate.

nodes.name: SWPC OVATION aurora forecast
nodes.summary: A 30 to 90 minute forecast of aurora location and intensity from the OVATION model, as a global 1-degree grid of [longitude, latitude, aurora] values in one JSON file.

auth.note: Public files; no key or token. Responses send access-control-allow-origin: * (checked 2026-09-24).

rateLimits.text: Not published. The files are static JSON regenerated on a schedule, so polling faster than they update gains nothing.

freshness.note: Regenerated every few minutes; the forecast lead time is the solar wind travel time from L1 to Earth (falls back to a Kp-driven estimate with no lead time when solar wind data is unavailable).

sample.responseExcerpt:
{
  "Observation Time": "2026-09-24T23:34:00Z",
  "Forecast Time": "2026-09-25T00:38:00Z",
  "Data Format": "[Longitude, Latitude, Aurora]",
  "coordinates": [[0, -90, 4], [0, -89, 0], [0, -88, 6], [0, -87, 8], ...]
}
(trimmed: about 65,000 grid points, roughly 1 MB)

nodes.notLiveReason: Not wired into the v1 map: a ~1 MB global intensity grid that would need its own heatmap layer. A candidate for a future live layer.

nodes.name: SWPC real-time solar wind (L1)
nodes.summary: One-minute solar wind plasma (speed, density, temperature) and interplanetary magnetic field (Bt, Bx/By/Bz in GSE and GSM) from whichever spacecraft at the L1 point is active, as JSON.

auth.note: Public files; no key or token. Responses send access-control-allow-origin: * (checked 2026-09-24).

rateLimits.text: Not published. The files are static JSON regenerated on a schedule, so polling faster than they update gains nothing.

freshness.note: One-minute data, roughly the past week per file (rtsw_wind_1m.json, rtsw_mag_1m.json). The source field names the active spacecraft (SOLAR1 at the time of checking).

sample.responseExcerpt:
[
  {
    "time_tag": "2026-09-24T23:40:00",
    "active": true,
    "source": "SOLAR1",
    "proton_speed": 432.8,
    "proton_temperature": 129322,
    "proton_density": 7.92,
    "proton_vx_gse": -432.0,
    ...
  },
  ...
]
(trimmed: each row also has GSM components, alpha-particle fields and quality flags)

nodes.notLiveReason: Not a map layer: measured 1.5 million km upstream of Earth, so there is no location on the globe to draw.

nodes.name: SWPC GOES X-ray, particle and magnetometer data
nodes.summary: Real-time GOES X-ray flux and flare events, proton and electron flux, magnetometer and EUV data from the primary and secondary GOES satellites, as JSON files covering the past 6 hours to 7 days.

auth.note: Public files; no key or token. Responses send access-control-allow-origin: * (checked 2026-09-24).

rateLimits.text: Not published. The files are static JSON regenerated on a schedule, so polling faster than they update gains nothing.

freshness.note: One-minute data; files are grouped by satellite (primary, secondary) and window (6-hour, 1-day, 3-day, 7-day).

sample.responseExcerpt:
[
  {
    "time_tag": "2026-09-24T17:44:00Z",
    "satellite": 18,
    "flux": 4.546471359390125e-07,
    "observed_flux": 4.6932447617109574e-07,
    "electron_correction": 1.4677340232083225e-08,
    "electron_contaminaton": false,
    "energy": "0.1-0.8nm"
  },
  ...
]
(trimmed: one row per minute for each of the two X-ray bands)

nodes.notLiveReason: Not a map layer: time series measured at geostationary orbit, not values for places on the globe.

nodes.name: NCEI GOES-R space weather archive
nodes.summary: The long-term archive of GOES-R space weather instrument data (EXIS X-ray and EUV, SEISS particles, MAG magnetometer, SUVI solar imagery) as daily Level 2 NetCDF files in a browsable HTTPS directory tree, by satellite, product, year and month.

auth.note: Public directory listings and file downloads; no account needed. access-control-allow-origin: * (checked 2026-09-24).

freshness.note: Daily science-quality files arrive about a day after the data date.

sample.responseExcerpt:
(HTML directory listing)
sci_xrsf-l2-avg1m_g19_d20260922_v2-2-1.nc  2026-09-23 04:20  282K
sci_xrsf-l2-avg1m_g19_d20260923_v2-2-1.nc  2026-09-24 04:22  285K
(trimmed: one file per day)
